name: Bush
ability: Grants a bush after a duration; at max level also grants a bush on elimination. Wait shortens with each level.
findNotes: Found in chests and supply drops during Chapter 7 Season 4 matches. Extract before the match ends.
levelNotes: Levels through normal play; bush cooldown improves each level.

name: Adventure
ability: Upgrades a random item in your inventory with each level up.
findNotes: Random chest / supply drop finds. Extract to keep permanently.

name: 8-Bit
ability: Puts an 8-Bit Shotgun in your first chest and grants a score multiplier for it.
findNotes: Season 4 chest drops. Extract before leaving the match.

name: Jonesy
ability: Recovers health or shields shortly after taking damage. Heal amount grows each level.
findNotes: Random finds in Season 4. Extract to unlock permanently.

name: Killswitch
ability: Aim while mid-air to slow down and gain improved accuracy. Accuracy grows with levels.
findNotes: Epic chest drop in Season 4. Extract to keep.

name: Sonic
ability: Sprint faster with each level up.
findNotes: Sonic collab sprite — chests and supply drops. Extract to unlock.

name: Tails
ability: Double jump to hover in mid-air. Hover speed grows with each level.
findNotes: Sonic collab — find in chests, extract before the end of the match.

name: Shadow
ability: Automatically reloads unequipped weapons over time. At max level also reloads the equipped weapon.
findNotes: Sonic collab epic. Extract from chests / drops.

name: Jackrabbit
ability: Grants a second mid-air jump. Cooldown shortens with each level.
findNotes: Legendary Season 4 drop. Extract to add to your locker.

name: Crown
ability: Levels only by winning matches — faster with Crown Wins. Mastering unlocks new variants.
findNotes: Mythic Season 4 sprite. Rare chest finds; extract carefully.
levelNotes: Only levels from match wins (boosted by Crown Wins).

name: Klombo
ability: Grants random items at each level. Levels only by consuming items; item quality improves each level.
findNotes: Mythic Season 4. Find, extract, then feed items to level.
levelNotes: Levels only by consuming items — not by eliminations or wins.
